name: relai-model-router
description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.321). RelAI Model Router: before a subagent starts, a helper model (the judge, haiku, 200 tokens, 8 s at most) reads its task and names the cheapest tier that will do it well — fast, balanced or deep, mapped to the project's RelAI model list (haiku, sonnet, opus by default). Lowering needs confidence 0.6 or more, raising 0.3; a task that may change production, move money or destroy data goes deep. A model the caller named is protected: a different suggestion asks the person by a card (suggestion, mine, always suggestion or always mine in this session); with no person in the session the suggestion applies. For /relai-crew, one card before the crew starts: the tool crew_models judges every task and shows a table (task, your model, suggestion, reason) in the pane 'RelAI crew models' with a pick per row, closed by one card (start with the picks, accept all suggestions, mine for all); a member decided there runs on that model with no second card. The main chat's model is never changed; forks, resumed agents and a mod's own subagents are left alone. A task with a secret found by the RelAI secret scanner never goes to the judge; a judge that fails, times out or answers badly leaves the model as it was and writes why to a file. Asks once per RelAI project (row 'Mody oszczędzania' in docs/USTAWIENIA.md) and stays passive in a session with no person before that answer. Sleeps while the BenAI 'model-router' mod is on. The pane (/relai-model-router pane) shows each choice with its reason and the judge's cost, and the switches; the command does the same: stats, on, off, pane, mine, suggestion, ask. The judge's cost goes to the RelAI savings ledger and is subtracted.
